title: Network device logs
description: Syslog of the VyOS leaves, fw-wan, MikroTik spines and CRS317s, FS switches and C9800 WLCs: BGP/BFD, interface, STP, login and config events, AP and client events, per-device timelines.

list.name: search
list.label: Search (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 regex on the line; empty matches everything.

panels.title: BGP / BFD
panels.description: FRR's %ADJCHANGE (bgpd, log-neighbor-changes) on VyOS; RouterOS session state lines ('<session> {l_addr: .., r_addr: ..} Established/Idle') and 'BFD session was not established'. FRR logs BFD state changes only at debug level, so they don't show up here.

panels.title: Interface up/down
panels.description: Kernel 'Link is Up/Down' (VyOS), RouterOS 'link up/down', Cisco/FS %LINK/%LINEPROTO UPDOWN.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:\blink is (up|down)\b|\blink (up|down)\b|updown|changed state to (up|down|administratively down)|carrier (lost|acquired))` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: STP
panels.description: Spanning tree: topology changes, port role/state changes (also Linux bridge port states on VyOS).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:spantree|\bstp\b|mstp|rstp|topology change|topo(logy)?[ _-]?change|entered (blocking|forwarding|disabled|listening|learning) state)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Auth failures
panels.description: Failed SSH/console logins: sshd, RouterOS 'login failure', FS 'auth fail', IOS-XE %SEC_LOGIN-4-LOGIN_FAILED.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:failed password|invalid user|authentication failure|login failure|auth fail|login_failed|authentication failed|failed publickey|maximum authentication attempts|bad password)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Successful logins: sshd 'Accepted ...', RouterOS/FS 'logged in', IOS-XE %SEC_LOGIN-5-LOGIN_SUCCESS. The automation on a0-nix (10.20.250.255) logs in often.

panels.title: Config changes
panels.description: VyOS commits, RouterOS '... changed by user', FS/IOS-XE 'Configured from' and saves.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:successful change to active configuration|config_i\b|%sys-\d-config|configured from|startup-config is wrote|\b(added|changed|removed|moved) by [a-z-]+:)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: AP join/leave
panels.description: C9800: access points joining or leaving the controller (%CAPWAPAC_SMGR_TRACE_MESSAGE-5-AP_JOIN_DISJOIN), AP reboots and AIR state.

panels.title: Client failures
panels.description: C9800: wireless clients excluded, failing 802.1X/MAB/web auth or being rejected.

panels.title: Events per device
panels.description: Every event of the categories above, per device and time bucket (darker = more). Only devices with events show up.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?:ADJCHANGE|\{l_addr: [^}]*\} [A-Za-z]+|(?i:state-change|bfd session|\bbgp\b.*\b(established|idle|notification|hold timer)\b))|(?:(?i:\blink is (up|down)\b|\blink (up|down)\b|updown|changed state to (up|down|administratively down)|carrier (lost|acquired)))|(?:(?i:spantree|\bstp\b|mstp|rstp|topology change|topo(logy)?[ _-]?change|entered (blocking|forwarding|disabled|listening|learning) state))|(?:(?i:failed password|invalid user|authentication failure|login failure|auth fail|login_failed|authentication failed|failed publickey|maximum authentication attempts|bad password))|(?:(?i:accepted (publickey|password|keyboard-interactive)|logged in|login_success))|(?:(?i:successful change to active configuration|config_i\b|%sys-\d-config|configured from|startup-config is wrote|\b(added|changed|removed|moved) by [a-z-]+:))|(?:(?i:ap_join|disjoin|ap event|ap_air_state|\bap\b.*\b(joined|disassociated|reboot)\b|capwap.*\b(join|down)\b))|(?:(?i:client_exclusion|exclusionlist|dot1x.*fail|mab.*fail|webauth.*fail|client.*(fail|reject|exclu|deauth|timeout)))` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Events by category
panels.description: One line can count in two categories (a 'login failure' line is also a login line on some devices).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:\blink is (up|down)\b|\blink (up|down)\b|updown|changed state to (up|down|administratively down)|carrier (lost|acquired))` [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:failed password|invalid user|authentication failure|login failure|auth fail|login_failed|authentication failed|failed publickey|maximum authentication attempts|bad password)` [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:successful change to active configuration|config_i\b|%sys-\d-config|configured from|startup-config is wrote|\b(added|changed|removed|moved) by [a-z-]+:)` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Lines per device
panels.description: All syslog lines of the selected devices. VyOS lines are sent twice (see Logs overview).

panels.title: BGP session changes
panels.description: FRR's %ADJCHANGE (VyOS leaves, fw-wan: peer(hostname) in vrf X Up/Down reason) and RouterOS session states (spines, CRS317: session name, remote address, state).

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `ADJCHANGE|\{l_addr: ` | regexp `neighbor (?P<peer_a>[^\s(]+)\s?(?:\((?P<name_a>[^)]*)\))? in vrf (?P<vrf>\S+) (?P<state_a>Up|Down)\s*(?P<reason>[^\n]*)` | regexp `(?P<name_b>\S+) \{l_addr: [^,]+, r_addr: (?P<peer_b>[^}]+)\} (?P<state_b>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format peer=`{{ or .peer_a .peer_b }}`, peer_name=`{{ or .name_a .name_b }}`, state=`{{ or .state_a .state_b }}`

panels.title: BGP / BFD log
panels.description: FRR's %ADJCHANGE (bgpd, log-neighbor-changes) on VyOS; RouterOS session state lines ('<session> {l_addr: .., r_addr: ..} Established/Idle') and 'BFD session was not established'. FRR logs BFD state changes only at debug level, so they don't show up here.

panels.title: Interface events per device
panels.description: Link up/down lines by device and the first 'up'/'down' in the line.

targets.expr: sum by (host, state) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:\blink is (up|down)\b|\blink (up|down)\b|updown|changed state to (up|down|administratively down)|carrier (lost|acquired))` | regexp `(?i)\b(?P<state>up|down)\b` | label_format state=`{{ lower .state }}` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Interface up/down
panels.description: Kernel 'Link is Up/Down' (VyOS), RouterOS 'link up/down', Cisco/FS %LINK/%LINEPROTO UPDOWN.

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:failed password|invalid user|authentication failure|login failure|auth fail|login_failed|authentication failed|failed publickey|maximum authentication attempts|bad password)`

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Successful logins: sshd 'Accepted ...', RouterOS/FS 'logged in', IOS-XE %SEC_LOGIN-5-LOGIN_SUCCESS. The automation on a0-nix (10.20.250.255) logs in often.

panels.title: Config changes
panels.description: VyOS commits, RouterOS '... changed by user', FS/IOS-XE 'Configured from' and saves.

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:successful change to active configuration|config_i\b|%sys-\d-config|configured from|startup-config is wrote|\b(added|changed|removed|moved) by [a-z-]+:)`

panels.title: AP join/leave
panels.description: C9800: access points joining or leaving the controller (%CAPWAPAC_SMGR_TRACE_MESSAGE-5-AP_JOIN_DISJOIN), AP reboots and AIR state.

panels.title: Message types (range)
panels.description: IOS-XE and FS messages by %FACILITY-SEVERITY-MNEMONIC in the time range.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (host, mnemonic) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"${device:regex}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |= "%" | regexp `%(?P<mnemonic>[A-Z0-9_]+-[0-7]-[A-Z0-9_]+)` | mnemonic!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Device logs
panels.description: Everything the selected devices sent, newest first.
